g.title: cluster_db
g.text: db (separate container — infrastructure only, no code)

g.title: note
g.text: Why sql-service.ts lives in monitoring-service, not db/:
• It imports the domain model (models/types.ts). Moving it to db/
would make INFRASTRUCTURE depend on APPLICATION code — backwards.
• db/ contains no code at all: a compose file, init.sql, verify.sh.
Adding TypeScript there would force package.json + pg into an
• Different lifecycles: init.sql runs once in the Postgres container;
sql-service.ts compiles into the monitoring-service image.
Counter-argument, acknowledged: schema and repository are tightly
coupled — add a column, both change. Cohesion favours co-location.
It loses to dependency direction: a repository translates rows into
domain objects, so it belongs on the domain's side of the boundary.
